full_track.tags: K-Pop and City Pop fusion. Clean electric guitar plays syncopated funk-style muted strums and ninth chords. A slap bass guitar performs a busy, percussive line with frequent slides and octaves. The drum kit features a crisp snare and a steady kick with sixteenth-note hi-hat patterns. Bright, polyphonic synth pads provide harmonic density. Male vocals are delivered in a rhythmic, melodic style with occasional falsetto ad-libs. The tempo is 115 BPM in the key of E Major.
